notes.title: Escape from Irene – Patch Notes
notes.content:
Escape from Irene – Patch Notes


[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45309152/5b46f2d49c0df05eb424e3fccd2bc87d1ffc7d7e.png"]
[hr][/hr]
Hello everyone!

While working on our next game, we noticed a few lingering issues in Escape from Irene that could impact your experience. This update aims to polish the gameplay and fix those bugs for good. 
Plus.. new language support is here!
[hr][/hr]New Translation
Added Spanish language support! Thanks to Sonic_Zone for the awesome translation!
[hr][/hr]Polish Update / Bug Fixes
Reduced door hit frequency for smoother gameplay

Fixed text hint display issues

Resolved the Reset button glitch

Fixed the Missripyourface visual bug

Fixed a tool usage glitch

Updated the dialogue system with improved features
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for playing and supporting Escape from Irene!

notes.title: We've made some updates to make it even better!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309152/ece3055cc6dfb6ac559a68b1c78c91e680438864.png

We are aware of the issues and are actively working on improvements to enhance the quality and enjoyment of the game for all players. this what we do on this Patch

Fixes
• Fixed bug MISSRIPYOURFACE.
• IreneRoom appears on the wrong day after the ending.

Additions
• Adjust the language change after the new ending.
• The screen size can be Full-screen / Windowed!
• Speed dialogue.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE | ESCAPE FROM IRENE
notes.content:
I got sick while working on the new patch, but everything is fine now.
I hope you all will love this update!

New Trailer for update: https://youtu.be/X60xriYaAjs
 
What's new in 3.0 Escape From Irene?
**Add**
• 13 Achievements
• Change way to Interact with Irene BIG CHANGE
• Change timer calculation in Escape Gameplay BIG CHANGE
• Add Status to interaction on player BIG CHANGE
• Add Irene Heart
• Add a new 7-slide puzzle
• Add SecretScene with Irene
• Add 3 New puzzles for guide point
• Add Skip Chapter Phase1 for the player who's Game over
• Add New Monster Miss RIPYOURFACE
• Add New Monster Mister RIPYOURHEART
• Add Guide Hint button for player stuckling
• Add Note
• Add Knock Icon
• Add Detail in note Knocking Puzzle
• Add hint in the note
• Monsters are now with you till you solve the puzzle
• Whisper New Gameplay
• Baby New Gameplay
• Extra Ending
• Add a setting bar in the pause menu
**Fixed**
• Cut some dialogue and focus more on engage
• Ending Escape Door Softlock
• Ending Live Softlock
• Smile Irene face glitch
• Observer Softlock
• Change Gameplay Note Music Puzzle
• Wrong Hint Position Mark In Night4 Room
• Fix Vase Night1 Image out of bound

notes.title: What the BUG?! Issues Fixed
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309152/bce9c1801c3ae20a6da48b21eeafd5a0145cc50e.png

We are aware of the issues and are actively working on improvements to enhance the quality and enjoyment of the game for all players. this what we do on this Patch

Fixes
• Screen size bug has been resolved
• Glitch Choice issue fixed
• Tutorial Glitch resolved
• Hand Glitch corrected
• Door Glitch fixed
• Observer Glitch patched
• Out-of-bounds issue in the Worm Scene resolved
• Ghost Door Glitch preventing end scene playback fixed
• Thai language corrections and wording adjustments

Additions
• Added a musical note icon for the sound puzzle and made improvements to better communicate with players
• Added a sound setting icon in the settings menu
• Save notification added to inform players when files are successfully saved
• Pause function implemented, allowing players to pause the game and exit
